span.p:
Auxiliary Losses (exp/exp_forecast.py 汇总)
• MoE: balance_switch + KL + z-loss + entropy
• FIR: L_spec (专家频率特化) + L_ortho
• TAN: 稳定性正则 (可选)
• Eval: --eval_target_only → utils/metrics.py 目标通道指标
